name: table-of-contents
title: Table of Contents
description: A sticky inline-start table of contents: thin lines that track the active section, dark tooltips with an image preview slider on hover or focus, and smooth jumps.
author: Batuhan Karasakal <https://github.com/batuhankarasakal>
docs:
Installed `TableOfContents` at `components/table-of-contents.tsx`, plus its color variables (`--table-of-contents-*`, light and dark).

Render it once per page with one entry per section: `<TableOfContents items={[{ id: "intro", title: "Intro", description: "What it is", images: ["/shots/intro.png"] }]} />`. Each `id` must match an element id on the page; the entry becomes active when that section's top passes 38% of the viewport (`activeMarkerRatio`). The bar is fixed to the inline-start edge and hidden below the `md` breakpoint.

Sounds are off by default; pass `enableSound` to opt in. Layout variables such as `--table-of-contents-left` and `--table-of-contents-top` can be overridden in CSS.

Accessibility settings: the default colors and 20px row spacing are upstream's. The default `rowHeight` of 20px fails WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8, which needs 24px targets (or the spacing exception); pass `rowHeight={24}` (or set `--table-of-contents-item-height: 24px`) to pass. The light tooltip description is 3.86:1; it rises to 5.71:1 under `prefers-contrast: more`, and you can raise it for everyone by setting `--table-of-contents-tooltip-muted` (for example to `#c4c4cc`).
